# Impressum

```{r}
#| output: false
library(readr)


impressum <- read_delim("publikumsbericht/impressum.csv", col_names = c("x","y"), delim = ";")

library(kableExtra)

impressum$x <- ifelse(is.na(impressum$x), "",impressum$x)
impressum$y <- ifelse(is.na(impressum$y), "",impressum$y)

```


```{r}
kable(impressum,col.names = c("",""))
```
